data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best all-round password manager.

It offers a good balance of security, ease of use, team collaboration and administration without requiring a dedicated IT team.

However, there are a few strong alternatives, particularly if you're a startup, a small business watching costs, or prefer open-source software.

## Best options compared

| Password manager | Best for | Approx. price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| 1Password | Best overall experience | \$24.95/month for 10 users |
| Bitwarden | Best value | \$4/user/month |
| Keeper | Security administration | From \$2/user/month |
| Proton Pass | Privacy-focused teams | From \$1.99/user/month |


Indicative USD pricing, generally on annual billing; check current UK pricing and VAT before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top three

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — best overall**

- Excellent desktop, mobile and browser apps.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Good administration and employee onboarding/offboarding.
- Particularly easy for non-technical employees.

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — best value**

- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Audit logs and directory synchronisation.
- Strong value for smaller budgets.

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — best for security controls**

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and delegated administration.
- Useful security and compliance features.

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

## What I'd actually choose

- **2–10 people\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack is particularly attractive at its published \$24.95 monthly price for up to 10 users.
- **10–30 people\:** Bitwarden Teams is worth serious consideration for cost-effective management.
- **Growing business with more demanding security requirements\:** 1Password Business or Keeper.

One important point: whichever you choose, make sure it supports\:

- Shared team vaults rather than shared master passwords.
- Individual employee accounts and permissions.
- Two-factor authentication (MFA).
- Immediate access revocation when someone leaves.
- Secure sharing of API keys, server credentials and other business secrets.
